evals.name: backend-retry-5min
evals.prompt: Writing up a demo for sprint review Friday — 5 min. Feature is the new connector retry policy in services/connector-sync. Before this, connector syncs against flaky partner APIs would silently fail on transient 5xx errors and we'd find out hours later when customer dashboards looked stale. Last quarter we paid $47K in SLA credits tied to this. The fix adds exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 5 attempts, and emits a structured event when we give up so oncall sees it immediately. Room is mostly engineering but our CTO and head of customer success will be there.

assertions.name: uses_timestamp_format
assertions.description: Output includes [MM:SS] timestamp markers throughout (e.g. [00:00], [02:30])

assertions.name: has_scene_structure
assertions.description: Output has distinct scenes/sections (at least 3) with time windows, not just flat bullet points

assertions.name: quotes_47k_number_early
assertions.description: The $47K SLA credits number appears in the first scene (hook/problem)

assertions.name: has_callback_to_hook
assertions.description: The $47K number or the problem framing is referenced again in the closing scene

assertions.name: includes_pre_demo_checklist
assertions.description: Output has a pre-demo checklist section listing specific prep items

assertions.name: includes_contingency_branches
assertions.description: Output has at least one branch/contingency for either audience-adaptation or failure recovery

assertions.name: includes_practice_marks
assertions.description: Output has a dedicated practice-marks section with specific timestamps to hit during rehearsal

assertions.name: includes_qa_section
assertions.description: Output has anticipated Q&A with at least 3 questions

assertions.name: no_theatrical_cues
assertions.description: Output does NOT contain stage-direction cues like [PAUSE], [beat], [slower], >> CLICK, [emphasize]

assertions.name: total_runtime_5min
assertions.description: Scene timestamps sum to approximately 5:00 (±30 seconds)

assertions.name: separates_tech_and_exec_qa
assertions.description: The Q&A section splits technical vs. exec-oriented questions

evals.name: ui-realtime-10min
evals.prompt: Need a 10-minute script for the new real-time query results in our data catalog. Users type a DataFusion SQL query, and instead of spinning while we fetch everything, rows stream in as they're computed. Also added a progress indicator, live cost estimate (credits consumed), and a cancel button. Demoing to our execs and a few prospects — they've seen the old catalog. Want to lead with 'the waiting is gone' not the technical architecture.

assertions.name: uses_timestamp_format
assertions.description: Output includes [MM:SS] timestamp markers throughout

assertions.name: six_beat_structure
assertions.description: Output has roughly 6 scenes matching the 10-min arc (hook, approach, show, turn, deep-dive, close)

assertions.name: total_runtime_10min
assertions.description: Scene timestamps sum to approximately 10:00 (±1 minute)

assertions.name: leads_with_value_not_architecture
assertions.description: Opening scene leads with 'the waiting is gone' / user experience framing, not with technical architecture

assertions.name: includes_pre_demo_checklist
assertions.description: Output has a pre-demo checklist

assertions.name: includes_contingency_branches
assertions.description: At least one branch for failure recovery (e.g., query hangs) or audience adaptation

assertions.name: technical_deep_dive_scene
assertions.description: Has a clearly-marked technical deep-dive scene that the presenter can include or skip based on audience

assertions.name: includes_practice_marks
assertions.description: Has a practice-marks section with specific timestamps

assertions.name: includes_qa_section
assertions.description: Has anticipated Q&A with at least 3 questions

assertions.name: no_theatrical_cues
assertions.description: Output does NOT contain stage-direction cues like [PAUSE], [beat], >> CLICK

assertions.name: addresses_prior_catalog_context
assertions.description: Acknowledges prospects have seen the old catalog (sets up the before/after)

assertions.name: names_the_turn_moment
assertions.description: There is a clearly identifiable 'aha' / turn moment in the script (e.g., first row streams in)

evals.name: thin-sso-input
evals.prompt: can you write me a demo script for our new SSO feature

assertions.name: asks_clarifying_questions
assertions.description: Assistant asks 1-2 targeted questions about the feature (e.g., aha moment, quantified impact) rather than inventing details

assertions.name: limits_questions_to_two
assertions.description: Assistant asks at most 2 questions, not an exhaustive interview

assertions.name: does_not_fabricate_numbers
assertions.description: If the assistant drafts anyway, it does not invent specific dollar amounts, customer counts, or latency numbers — it flags gaps instead

assertions.name: flags_gaps_if_drafts
assertions.description: If the assistant produces a draft with placeholders, the placeholders are clearly marked as gaps for the user to fill

evals.name: textream-export-ui245
evals.prompt: Take the demo script at ~/.agent/demo-scripts/ui-245-simplify-nav-2026-04-17.md and export it to textream format so I can use it as a teleprompter feed. Save the .textream file alongside the .md.

assertions.name: output_is_valid_json_array
assertions.description: The .textream file parses as a JSON array (json.loads succeeds) and the top-level is a list

assertions.name: array_elements_are_strings
assertions.description: Every element in the array is a string, not an object or nested array

assertions.name: one_element_per_scene
assertions.description: The array has exactly 4 elements, one per SCENE in the source .md (SCENE 1 through SCENE 4)

assertions.name: rehearsal_sections_dropped
assertions.description: No substring from 'Pre-demo checklist', 'Contingencies', 'Anticipated Q&A', 'Practice marks', or 'Notes for the presenter' appears anywhere in the JSON content

assertions.name: scene_titles_and_timestamps_dropped
assertions.description: The strings 'SCENE', '[00:00', '[00:45', '[02:30', '[03:15' do not appear in the JSON content — scene titles and time windows are not in the teleprompter version

assertions.name: branches_dropped
assertions.description: The literal string 'Branch —' does not appear anywhere in the JSON content

assertions.name: talk_track_preserved
assertions.description: Each scene's talk track content is substantially preserved — at least the anchor phrases 'Two clicks, redundant naming', 'One click, straight in', 'The thing I want you to notice isn\'t the icon', 'one form to fill out' all appear in the output

assertions.name: actions_use_uppercase_brackets
assertions.description: Action cues use uppercase verbs in brackets (e.g., '[CLICK', '[SWITCH', '[OPEN', '[RELOAD', '[LOG OUT'). At least 5 distinct uppercase action cues are present across the array.

assertions.name: delivery_cues_normalized_lowercase
assertions.description: Delivery cues are lowercase: '[pause]', '[beat]', '[slower]'. No '[PAUSE]' (uppercase standalone PAUSE) appears in the output — source uppercase delivery cues have been normalized

assertions.name: delivery_cues_preserved
assertions.description: The source's delivery cues survive the translation: at least one '[pause]', one '[beat]', and one '[slower]' appear in the output

assertions.name: file_saved_to_expected_path
assertions.description: The output file is saved to ~/.agent/demo-scripts/ui-245-simplify-nav-2026-04-17.textream (same slug + date as the source .md, with .textream extension)

assertions.name: md_untouched
assertions.description: The source .md file is not modified by the export — textream is an additional artifact, not a replacement

assertions.name: branch_warning_in_chat
assertions.description: The assistant's chat message mentions that branches from the .md were dropped from the .textream version (scenes 1, 2, 3, and 4 all had branches in the source), so the user knows the teleprompter is happy-path only
